name: "pb"

imports:
   - name: cel.expr.conformance.proto3.TestAllTypes
   - name: cel.expr.conformance.proto3.TestAllTypes.NestedEnum
   - name: cel.expr.conformance.proto3.GlobalEnum

rule:
  match:
    - condition: >
        spec.single_int32 > cel.expr.conformance.proto3.TestAllTypes{single_int64: 10}.single_int64
      output: |
        "invalid spec, got single_int32=" + string(spec.single_int32) + ", wanted <= 10"
    - condition: >
        spec.standalone_enum == NestedEnum.BAR ||
        NestedEnum.BAZ in spec.repeated_nested_enum ||
        GlobalEnum.GAR == GlobalEnum.GOO
      output: |
        "invalid spec, neither nested nor repeated enums may refer to BAR or BAZ"

match.condition: spec.standalone_enum == NestedEnum.BAR || NestedEnum.BAZ in spec.repeated_nested_enum || GlobalEnum.GAR == GlobalEnum.GOO
match.output: "invalid spec, neither nested nor repeated enums may refer to BAR or BAZ"

description: "Protobuf input tests"
section:
  - name: "valid"
    tests:
      - name: "good spec"
        input:
          spec:
            expr: >
              cel.expr.conformance.proto3.TestAllTypes{single_int32: 10}
        output:
          expr: "optional.none()"
  - name: "invalid"
    tests:
      - name: "bad spec"
        input:
          spec:
            expr: >
              cel.expr.conformance.proto3.TestAllTypes{single_int32: 11}
        output:
          value: "invalid spec, got single_int32=11, wanted <= 10"
